title: EventEnvelope
description: Kiosk raw event envelope v1 (plan section 6.1, ING-01). Discriminated union on event_type. Writers keep additionalProperties:false; readers tolerate unknown fields (minor N+1).

payload_session_start.title: SessionStartPayload
payload_session_start.description: First event of every session. Records the session seed and arm assignment.

payload_session_context.title: SessionContextPayload
payload_session_context.description: Session covariates (SessionContext). May be re-emitted when bands or calibration change.

payload_language_selected.title: LanguageSelectedPayload
payload_language_selected.description: Language chosen by tapping a speaking face.

payload_language_switched.title: LanguageSwitchedPayload
payload_language_switched.description: Language switch via the globe icon.

payload_consent_granted.title: ConsentGrantedPayload
payload_consent_granted.description: Consent committed by tap only (never by voice).

payload_consent_declined.title: ConsentDeclinedPayload
payload_consent_declined.description: Consent declined. Only an anonymous counter is retained for declined core consent.

payload_optin_contact.title: OptinContactPayload
payload_optin_contact.description: Contact opt-in. Boolean only; contact details never enter event tables.

payload_bands_answered.title: BandsAnsweredPayload
payload_bands_answered.description: Picture-band answers. Under-18 selections are never logged.

payload_practice_summary.title: PracticeSummaryPayload
payload_practice_summary.description: Practice + warm-up outcome and motor covariates (not scorable).

payload_calibration_result.title: CalibrationResultPayload
payload_calibration_result.description: Calibration level locked for the session.

payload_module_start.title: ModuleStartPayload
payload_module_start.description: A game module or episode starts.

payload_module_end.title: ModuleEndPayload
payload_module_end.description: A game module or episode ends.

payload_trial_start.title: TrialStartPayload
payload_trial_start.description: A trial begins (stimulus not yet presented).

presented_onset_ms.description: rAF after commit plus per-SKU display offset.

audio_onset_ms.description: Web Audio clock plus per-SKU audio offset.

payload_stimulus_onset.title: StimulusOnsetPayload
payload_stimulus_onset.description: Stimulus presentation timing (ENG-01). Times are on the session monotonic clock.

payload_prompt_audio_end.title: PromptAudioEndPayload
payload_prompt_audio_end.description: End of a spoken prompt (latency anchor audio_end).

payload_prompt_window_open.title: PromptWindowOpenPayload
payload_prompt_window_open.description: A response window opens (the microphone may open only inside a consented window).

latency_ms.description: Signed latency from latency_anchor. Negative with barge_in=true when before the anchor; null only for timeouts.

revisions.description: Every change before confirmation, in order.

payload_response.title: ResponsePayload
payload_response.description: Committed response (closed code). Latency is signed; null only on timeout.

payload_asr_result.title: AsrResultPayload
payload_asr_result.description: Closed-vocabulary ASR proposal. No alternatives in production.

pointer_t_ms.description: PointerEvent.timeStamp mapped to the session clock minus the per-SKU touch offset.

anchor_offset_ms.description: Signed offset from the current latency anchor.

payload_input_raw_tap.title: InputRawTapPayload
payload_input_raw_tap.description: Every raw tap, never debounced (extra and premature taps included).

shift_index.description: Trial index at which the shift takes effect.

payload_context_shift.title: ContextShiftPayload
payload_context_shift.description: A controlled condition change. The only valid source of switch points for scoring.

payload_report.title: ReportPayload
payload_report.description: Private report. Only the reported value is logged; the true outcome is never logged (dice mode a).

payload_walkaway_resumed.title: WalkawayResumedPayload
payload_walkaway_resumed.description: Player resumed after a walkaway prompt.

payload_session_abandoned.title: SessionAbandonedPayload
payload_session_abandoned.description: Session abandoned; consented events are kept, there is no resume.

payload_env_noise_dbfs.title: EnvNoiseDbfsPayload
payload_env_noise_dbfs.description: Noise floor inside a consented prompt window.

payload_researcher_annotation.title: ResearcherAnnotationPayload
payload_researcher_annotation.description: Think-aloud observer code (closed codebook; no free text).

payload_invalid.title: InvalidPayload
payload_invalid.description: Placeholder written with the same seq when an event fails validation; keeps seq gapless.

payload_session_tombstone.title: SessionTombstonePayload
payload_session_tombstone.description: Tombstone covering uploaded and not-yet-uploaded events of this session.

context.title: EventSessionContext
context.description: Session context carried on every event. participant_pid is null until consent and linkage.

synthetic.description: True for simulator-generated data (QA-02); kept out of real tables.

task.title: EventTaskPosition
task.description: Task position; null for session-level events.

condition.title: EventCondition
condition.description: Experimental condition; null for session-level events.

t_mono_ms.description: Monotonic ms since the session anchor (performance.now based). Never decreases within a session.

kiosk_t_wall.description: Kiosk wall clock. Informational only; used for clock-offset estimation, never for ordering.

scorable.description: False for practice, warm-up and onboarding events.

interrupted.description: True when a pause interrupted the trial; excluded from latency indicators.

server.title: EventServerFields
server.description: Populated by the backend at ingestion. Kiosks always send nulls.

seq.description: Gapless per-session sequence number allocated in the same transaction as the event row.
